## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

---

### 1. 本季度收入同比增长百分比及计算过程

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | 数值 | 出处 |
|------|------|------|
| Q4 FY26 Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | press_release.txt 财务数据表，"Three Months Ended June 30, 2026" 行 |
| Q4 FY25 Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $29,878 百万 | press_release.txt 财务数据表，"Three Months Ended June 30, 2025" 行 |

**同比增长率（GAAP）= (39,306 − 29,878) / 29,878 × 100 = 9,428 / 29,878 × 100 ≈ 31.6%，按财报口径取整为 32%。**

这与 press_release.txt 中明确写的 "Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)" 一致，metrics.txt 也给出 Q4'26 同比 32% 的记录。

---

### 2. 管理层在财报电话会上的归因（原文引用）

Amy Hood 在电话会中对 Intelligent Cloud 增长原因的说明（transcript.txt 第 ~24808 字符起）：

> **a) Azure 强劲需求：** "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.**"

> **b) 效率提升与产能交付加速：** "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.**"

> **c) 新增产能被快速变现：** "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was **quickly monetized.**"

> **d) GitHub Copilot 消费超预期：** "Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption** following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

> **e) 服务器业务：** "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations **primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

---

### 3. 逐条标注：已发生的事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

| 归因 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|------|------|----------|
| (a) 客户对 Azure 的需求持续超过可用产能 | **已发生的事实** | Amy Hood 使用现在时态陈述："Customer demand **continues** to exceed available capacity"，并引用本季度实际数据（Azure +43%）作为支撑 |
| (b) CPU/GPU 机群效率提升和流程改进使新产能提前交付 | **已发生的事实** | Amy Hood 描述本季度已发生的效率改进："We saw a good work this quarter, in particular, from our engineering teams…" 以及 "we've reduced dock-to-live times for new GPUs in our largest regions by nearly 50%"（Satya Nadella 在开场白中） |
| (c) 新增产能被快速变现 | **已发生的事实** | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" — "was" 为过去时，描述 Q4 已发生的事 |
| (d) GitHub Copilot 消费超预期 | **已发生的事实** | "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption" — 直接归因于 Q4 实际结果 |
| (e) 服务器业务续约带来更高的在期确认收入 | **已发生的事实** | "Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition" — 描述已完成的 Q4 结果 |
| (f) H1 FY27 Azure 增长将加速 | **前瞻性表述** | Amy Hood 明确说："Even with the strong close to Q4, we **continue to expect** H1 growth to accelerate" — 使用"expect"及现在进行时表未来预期 |
| (g) 需求将持续超过供给，使效率收益"快速变现"成为持续模式 | **前瞻性表述** | Amy Hood 在 Q&A 中说："when we can make efficiency gains, they are quickly monetized in quarter. And I think that dynamic **certainly impacted the quarter positively**" 前半句描述已发生，但该句整体与后续 "we continue to expect" 语境连用，构成对未来趋势的预判；同时她说 "I think we've continued to say… that demand continues to exceed available supply" 表面上是事实陈述，但下一句 "And we **remain focused on** delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps" 指向未来行动 |

**区分依据总结：**
- **已发生的事实**：动词使用过去时（was, grew, were, impacted）或对 Q4 已发生现象的直接描述，且有本季度实际数据佐证。
- **前瞻性表述**：动词使用 expect / continue to / will / 将来时态，或明确指向 FY27 / Q1 FY27 等未来期间，或使用"continues to say… remains true"等虽为现在时但指向未来持续状态的措辞。同时，press_release.txt 中所有 "Business Outlook" 与 "guide" 相关段落也均属于前瞻性表述，需单独标记。
